highlights.title: A failed AI download offers Try again
highlights.text: If the Claude or Grok download fails in Get started (no internet, say), the step now stops with "Couldn't get Claude ready." and a Try again button instead of spinning forever.

highlights.title: Connect an app right from the bot's card
highlights.text: When a bot suggests connecting Gmail, the card's Connect Gmail button opens the Connect sheet for Gmail with that bot already ticked. Once it's connected, the card says so.

fixes: New ready-made teams' instructions now speak to you directly, and each teammate's persona starts with its own name and role.
In Get started, Add account for an API key stays off until you paste a key, so no empty account is made.
Renaming a bot or the handle of a suggested team before creating it now reaches its instructions, skills and rules too.
